caption: Per-round loop diagnostics on the 300 annotated micrographs.
note: Round 0 picks with the base checkpoint; round n picks with the checkpoint trained on the teacher labels of round n-1. `picks` is the number of candidates on the annotated micrographs. `precision`, `recall` and `f1` are macro scores of that round's picks against the CryoPPP annotations, averaged per micrograph, kept at three decimals as the paper prints them. `after_purify_count` is the number of particles left after contamination masking and 2D selection, and `after_purify_share` is that count as a percent of `picks` in the same round. The loop runs no reconstruction, so this table carries no resolution and the EMPIAR-10345 pixel-size caveat does not apply to it. All values come from the full fine-tuning arm (loop arm general_full, prefix fbf_r), which is the paper's method; an earlier LoRA arm gave different counts and is not reported here.

provenance.source: sec/5_results.tex, tab:loop_rounds, for the published values; docs/notes/5_results.md in the manuscript repository, the tab:loop_rounds heading and the section-wide raw-value block that follows it
provenance.detail: Aggregated from each round's state.json with what is now src/rapick/loop/round_metrics.py, on the full fine-tuning arm the paper reports; the notes give 2026-08-20 as the read-out date.

not_in_paper.note: The intermediate stages of the funnel, an extra round on 10081, and the per-round rates the table no longer prints.

funnel_counts.note: Order: picks / passing the contamination mask / accepted by 2D classification / surviving CryoSift. The first and last are the two columns the paper prints.

permanent_discard_pct_unrounded.note: (n_class2d - attractor_kept - round0_kept) / n_class2d, the share of the particles reaching 2D classification that the first CryoSift iteration rejects permanently. Dropped with fig:loop on 2026-08-20.

final_survival_pct_unrounded.note: kept_particles / n_class2d. Different denominator from `after_purify_share`, which divides by picks.

round_4_10081.note: Only the 2D scores exist for this round; 2D classification and CryoSift were not run past round 3, and the other three entries stop at round 3, so the paper reports rounds 0 to 3 on all four.

macro_f1_spread_rounds_1_to_3.note: The paper's claim that rounds 2 and 3 stay within 0.013 macro F1 of round 1 is this spread, with EMPIAR-10345 the exception it names separately.

round0_teacher_label_quality.note: The round-0 teacher labels scored against the CryoPPP annotations of the 50 micrographs the teacher is drawn from, pooled: precision, recall, and labels per micrograph. Source: recon-aware-pick docs/picker_fb/round_operating_point.md, quoted in docs/notes/5_results.md.

round0_base_checkpoint_ungated_scores.note: An unresolved discrepancy worth knowing about. The notes record a second set of round-0 base-checkpoint scores that do NOT match the round 0 row above, on the same annotated micrographs: 10081 0.469 / 0.954 / 0.610 with 77,327 picks, 10093 0.352 / 0.737 / 0.475 with 118,310, 10345 0.187 / 0.966 / 0.299 with 87,445, 10532 0.459 / 0.620 / 0.514 with 116,753. These are the values the paper prints as the CryoTransformer row of tab:f1_vs_res (Table S2). The notes label the loop-table numbers as the gated values, measured after the contamination mask, and give 10081 as 0.530 / 0.919 / 0.655 with 65,386 picks and 10532 as 0.459 / 0.580 / 0.498 with 108,456, against 65,385 and 108,453 in the table. Nothing in the notes reconciles the small count differences, and no gated pair is recorded for 10093 or 10345.
